Stage-scope unqualified colon-style var declarations remain outside the native v0 accepted surface; function-body colon-style locals have separate accepted evidence.
Extended CrossTL stage spellings are outside the native v0 accepted surface unless a future target-specific package row names them.
For-in loop statements are outside the native v0 accepted surface; native v0 currently supports C-style for loops.
Generics are outside the native v0 accepted surface.
Impl blocks are outside the native v0 accepted surface.
Imports are outside the native v0 accepted surface.
Backslash-newline physical line splicing remains translator/importer tolerance, not native-v0 shared .cgl syntax.
Malformed/incomplete C-style for headers are outside the native v0 accepted control-flow surface.
Match and pattern-control forms are outside the native v0 accepted surface.
Preprocessor directives are outside the native v0 accepted surface.
Ray any-hit stage spelling is CrossTL-only until native stage, HIR, and target contracts exist.

Duplicate folded scalar switch case labels are outside the restricted native v0 switch subset.
Grouped switch case labels are outside the restricted native v0 switch subset.
Switch case labels with scalar types incompatible with the selector are outside the restricted native v0 switch subset.
Non-terminal switch-local breaks are outside the restricted native v0 switch subset.
Fallthrough and grouped switch/case/default forms are outside the restricted native v0 switch subset.
Tessellation stage spellings are CrossTL-only until native stage, HIR, and target contracts exist.
Trait declarations are outside the native v0 accepted surface.
Only workgroup/shared var address spaces are inside the native v0 accepted surface.
